beats.name: BK2VIII-03a · The cows by the lighthouse
beats.words: …some dear cows who came nosing towards us in a field close to the lighthouse, and frightened the wits out of us.

beats.name: BK2VIII-03b · Tea at Robin Hood’s Bay
beats.words: We had a capital “severe tea” at Robin Hood’s Bay in a sweet little old-fashioned inn, with a bow-window right over the seaweed-covered rocks…
beats.prompt: BK2VIII-03b oil on canvas, visible brushstrokes, soft painterly edges, in the manner of John Singer Sargent and Atkinson Grimshaw, 1890s, wide view, the fishing village of Robin Hood’s Bay on the Yorkshire coast at golden evening, red-roofed cottages tumbling down the cliff to the sea, an old inn with a bow-window over the seaweed-covered rocks of the strand, the tide out --ar 16:9 --sref https://ianingram.github.io/Amenti-Readings/dracula/art/ch08-cliff-b3.jpg --no text, lettering, modern, abstract, people close up

beats.at: the silver light of the moon struck
beats.name: BK2VIII-04a · Something dark bent over her
beats.words: …on our favourite seat, the silver light of the moon struck a half-reclining figure, snowy white… something dark stood behind the seat… and bent over it.
beats.note: The key horror beat of the chapter: show the shape, never the face.
beats.prompt: BK2VIII-04a oil on canvas, visible brushstrokes, soft painterly edges, in the manner of John Singer Sargent and Atkinson Grimshaw, 1890s, night, a sword-cut of moonlight between racing clouds falling on the clifftop churchyard of St Mary’s at Whitby, a young woman in a snowy white nightdress half-reclining on a bench among the tombstones, and behind the bench a tall dark shape bending low over her, only its outline and two red gleaming eyes visible, the ruined abbey black against the sky --ar 16:9 --sref https://ianingram.github.io/Amenti-Readings/dracula/art/ch08-sleep-gate-3.jpg --no text, lettering, modern, abstract, face, gore, blood

beats.words: …I did not wait to catch another glance, but flew down the steep steps to the pier and along by the fish-market to the bridge…

beats.at: something long and dark with red eyes
beats.name: BK2VIII-33a · Lucy’s dream
beats.words: …something long and dark with red eyes… something very sweet and very bitter all around me at once; and then I seemed sinking into deep green water…

beats.name: BK2VIII-54a · Over the wall to Carfax
beats.words: I got a ladder myself, and crossing the wall, dropped down on the other side. I could see Renfield’s figure just disappearing behind the angle of the house…
